comment: All choices shared Adam and a small nominal displacement, Δ=0.00768. Normalization and signal propagation favored D and C over the zero-LN candidates (K1006, K1009). D’s residual ReLU recipe ranked ahead of C’s plain SiLU recipe, but this bundled comparison does not establish a general residual or activation rule. Among zero-LN models, the shallower A and E beat the deep plain B, consistent with avoiding signal attenuation at this short, low-rate budget. K1056 helped by limiting the trained-regime smooth-activation preference rather than applying it here. No new tested general rule follows.
